name: planning-operation-reads
goal: One planning operation reads each revision-pinned Git object once, with the same results and every operation seeing new commits, branches and approvals.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: change-reply first test: 828 Git processes, 656 exact repeats; 819 from planning planGit, mostly blob ls-tree/show pinned to full commit ids, repeated within one API call.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: test/utils/plan-reads.test.ts with HEAD PlanningService in a disposable copy: exit 1, expected 4 to be +0 (repeated pinned reads in one readPlan); second case passed.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: planReads: per-operation memo of show/ls-tree/log/rev-parse pinned to full ids; planningService makes one per call. No HEAD, write, input or failed read cached.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same test: 2/2 passed; equal readPlan/readImage, zero repeated pinned reads, sees approval, branch move, external commit. Lint, typecheck green; desktop affected 22/22.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
planReads is shown by planning-artifacts operation-read-isolation: two real-fixture and five port tests, mapped, wrapped, with traces.
steps.evidence: Supervised CheckRunService, candidate worktree: plan-reads 2 tests/10 matchers, plan-reads-port 5/9, counts equal, 7 function-invocations traces. Normal planning check 45/45 at 20 s.
